record.title: Migrated 42 workflows off a paid tool to self-hosted
record.text: Got tired of being billed per polling trigger. Moved all forty-two workflows to a self-hosted instance last week. The cost difference is about two hundred per month. The manual migration took a weekend and the integration broke twice.
